notes: Fixes a sign-in failure that could look exactly like the relay refusing you. A stray relay address saved in the app's local settings (127.0.0.1 — your own PC, left there by a test run on a dev machine) made every sign-in dial the wrong place and fail instantly, reported as 'rate-limiting' by older builds and 'the relay isn't answering' by v0.12.14 — while the relay itself was fine. This build clears any such loopback address automatically at launch, and fixes the related trap where re-entering the correct relay address worked for one session but didn't stick. Housekeeping: the update tests no longer leave large temporary files behind on dev machines. If v0.12.14's sign-in worked for you, nothing changes.
